privacy: Metrics and text only. Bedroom (owner-room-01) splats/renders stay on the box (chmod 700) and the private gj-corpus:/owner-capture/room-01/ volume (AUTH #046).

setup.recipe: quality-30k (30K iters, bilateral grid, scale reg) at the 400K display budget (growth limit in training + hard cap in ns_finish, no post-prune)
setup.held_out: every 8th frame, scored by ns_finish with the trained rasterize mode
setup.floater_proxy: share of splats that are isolated (<4 neighbours in 3x3x3 voxels), giant or needle (tools/weak_regions.py statistics); corpus PLYs are in nerfstudio's normalised frame, so thresholds scale with the room extent E (voxel E/60, giant E/25, needle ratio>9.5 & >E/120), identical for both arms of a room; lower is better

unity_path: see unity_path_bedroom (added when scored); the shipped GJSplatUtilities.compute always applies gsplat antialiased opacity compensation, so a classic-trained splat is mis-matched on device unless a shader branch is added

decision.rule: Flip a knob only if the arm wins held-out LPIPS on >=3/4 corpus rooms without a mean PSNR loss >0.3 dB and without raising the floater proxy; if mixed, run single-factor arms before flipping.
decision.result: MIXED. antialiased+mcmc wins PSNR 4/4 (mean +0.29 dB) and the floater proxy 3/4 (isolated splats -75..-89%), but LOSES LPIPS 4/4 (+0.003..+0.034) -> fails the LPIPS gate.
decision.flip: NONE. ReconstructionConfig defaults stay rasterize_mode='classic', densify_strategy='default'. The measured shipping recipes (quality-30k*, budget profiles) keep training antialiased via recipe_rasterize_mode, which matches the AA-only Unity shader.
decision.attribution: Bedroom single-factor evidence (same 29 views): antialiased-default vs classic-default = LPIPS 0.1244 vs 0.1257, PSNR -0.08 dB, proxy 0.035 vs 0.041 (AA neutral-to-better); MCMC is the LPIPS loser (bedroom 0.171; PSNR -0.75 dB) while cutting isolated floaters ~7x. Working hypothesis: MCMC at a fixed 400K cap trades fine detail (LPIPS) for fewer floaters / higher PSNR; antialiased is neutral.
decision.next: Single-factor arms on the 4 corpus rooms: antialiased-default (4 runs, ~$2.2) decides the rasterize_mode default; classic-mcmc (4 runs, ~$2.2) only if MCMC is to be reconsidered (e.g. with tuned noise/opacity reg). Not run: would exceed today's $7 hard stop (this A/B ~$5.1 est).
